contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 so n=6 lies outside published CKgP range and needs new CE geometry) and with the packet C66-GEO-Z bottleneck. Primary check against SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (Canning–Larson arXiv:2208.02357v2 / JEMS 2024): W:=O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*F^∨ is rank 2; on geometric fibres with F=O(f1)⊕O(f2) one has W=W_{f1}⊕W_{f2} and deg(W_{fi}|_C)=4g+12-4f_i, so for g=6 and balanced (f1,f2)=(4,5) one gets deg 20 and 16 respectively, matching the filtered sub/quotient degrees. Fibrewise Grothendieck splitting on P^1 and Ext^1(O(4),O(5))=H^1(O(1))=0 are standard; the relative obstruction to a global split is therefore purely H^1 of π_*Hom on the base, so assuming W=W_4⊕W_5 over the universal balanced stack is a genuine extra hypothesis. Fitting equality for isomorphic cokernels is standard (Stacks Project, Fitting ideals). Corroborated packet findings FND-0062 and FND-0063 supply the fibrewise coker(φ_4)=0 and failure-on-W_5 inputs used by the snake step; FND-0046 and FND-0096 concern Fitting/scheme structure of evaluation failure and are complementary, not opposed. No adjudicated finding already states that filtration (not global split) suffices for Fit_0, so there is no merge target. Residual caveats (precise relative π_* exactness needs CBC on the W_4 piece; the finding asserts that global Ext need not vanish rather than computing a nonzero class on the specific universal stack) do not undermine the removable-hypothesis half, which is the load-bearing obstruction for C66-GEO-Z.

scope.mathematical_scope: Over any base B carrying a relative rank-2 CE scroll bundle F of constant fibrewise type O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5), the relative HN filtration yields a canonical SES 0→L_5→F→L_4→0; dualizing and twisting by O_{P(E^∨)}(2) yields 0→W_4→W→W_5→0 with W_4 the degree-20 subbundle (f=4) and W_5 the degree-16 quotient (f=5) on geometric fibres. For Γ finite over B, restriction to Γ and the induced evaluation maps form a morphism of short exact sequences of O_B-modules (after the usual cohomology-and-base-change vanishings on the positive-degree W_4 piece). Fibrewise vanishing of the f=4 obstruction (deg ω⊗W_4^∨(Γ)=-4) gives coker(φ_4)=0, so the snake lemma yields coker(φ)≅coker(φ_5) as modules and therefore Fit_0(coker φ)=Fit_0(coker φ_5) with no global splitting of W. Global splitting W≅W_4⊕W_5 is strictly stronger: fibrewise Ext^1_{P^1}(O(4),O(5))=H^1(O(1))=0, so the only obstruction is global and lives in H^1(B,π_*Hom(L_4,L_5)), which need not vanish for a general base and in particular is an unverified extra hypothesis over the universal balanced tetragonal stack used by C66-GEO-Z/H0/COMP. Campaign statements should use the filtered form of the CE reduction.
